# Single-file HTML canvas games

Follow these conventions when you build a browser game in one HTML file.

## Structure
- One `index.html` with inline `<style>` and one inline `<script>`; no external libraries or assets.
- A single `<canvas>` sized with CSS to fit the window while keeping its aspect ratio; draw at a fixed logical resolution (for example 800x600) and scale.
- Keep the code in this order: constants, state, input, update, draw, game loop, start.

## Game loop
- Drive the loop with `requestAnimationFrame` and a delta time in seconds, clamped to 1/30 s so a background tab does not make objects jump.
- Keep `update(dt)` and `draw()` separate; never draw inside update.
- Use a small state machine: `title`, `playing`, `levelClear`, `gameOver`, `win`.

## Input
- Keyboard: arrow keys and A/D to move, Space or Enter to start, launch and restart. Track pressed keys in a set on `keydown`/`keyup` and call `preventDefault()` for the arrow keys and Space.
- Mouse: move the paddle or player with `mousemove` using the canvas bounding rectangle; click to start or launch.
- Touch: mirror the mouse handlers with `touchstart`/`touchmove` and `{ passive: false }`.

## Gameplay details
- Store levels as arrays of strings, one character per brick or tile, so a level is easy to read and edit.
- Show score, lives and level in a HUD drawn on the canvas.
- Give the player a short pause and a message between levels and after losing a life.
- Make collisions robust: move in small steps or resolve along the axis of least penetration so fast objects do not tunnel.

## Finish
- Check that the file opens without console errors and that every state can be reached.
- Keep the file under about 600 lines.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #0b0e1a; overflow: hidden; }
  body { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: min(100vw, calc(100vh * 4 / 3));
    height: min(100vh, calc(100vw * 3 / 4));
    background: #141a2e;
    cursor: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// ---------- Constants ----------
const W = 800, H = 600;
const PADDLE_W = 110, PADDLE_H = 14, PADDLE_Y = H - 40, PADDLE_SPEED = 560;
const BALL_R = 7;
const BRICK_W = 64, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_TOP = 70;
const START_LIVES = 3;
const PAUSE_TIME = 1.5;

// Levels: '.' = empty, 1-3 = brick hit points, '#' = unbreakable
const LEVELS = [
  {
    speed: 340,
    rows: [
      "1111111111",
      "1111111111",
      "2222222222",
      "1111111111",
      "1111111111",
    ],
  },
  {
    speed: 400,
    rows: [
      "3.3.33.3.3",
      "2222222222",
      "2#2#22#2#2",
      "1111111111",
      ".11111111.",
      "..111111..",
    ],
  },
];

const COLORS = { 1: "#4fc3f7", 2: "#ffb74d", 3: "#ef5350", "#": "#78909c" };

// ---------- State ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let state = "title"; // title, playing, levelClear, gameOver, win
let score = 0, lives = START_LIVES, levelIndex = 0;
let bricks = [];
let paddle = { x: W / 2 - PADDLE_W / 2 };
let ball = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, stuck: true };
let pauseTimer = 0;
let message = "";

function loadLevel(i) {
  levelIndex = i;
  bricks = [];
  const rows = LEVELS[i].rows;
  const cols = rows[0].length;
  const totalW = cols * BRICK_W + (cols - 1) * BRICK_GAP;
  const left = (W - totalW) / 2;
  rows.forEach((row, r) => {
    [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
      if (ch === ".") return;
      bricks.push({
        x: left + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
        y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
        hp: ch === "#" ? Infinity : Number(ch),
        maxHp: ch === "#" ? 0 : Number(ch),
        solid: ch === "#",
      });
    });
  });
  resetBall();
}

function resetBall() {
  paddle.x = W / 2 - PADDLE_W / 2;
  ball.stuck = true;
  ball.vx = 0;
  ball.vy = 0;
  stickBall();
}

function stickBall() {
  ball.x = paddle.x + PADDLE_W / 2;
  ball.y = PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1;
}

function launchBall() {
  if (!ball.stuck) return;
  const speed = LEVELS[levelIndex].speed;
  const angle = (-Math.PI / 2) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6;
  ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
  ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
  ball.stuck = false;
}

function newGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = START_LIVES;
  loadLevel(0);
  state = "playing";
}

// Single "action" button: start / launch / restart
function action() {
  if (state === "title" || state === "gameOver" || state === "win") newGame();
  else if (state === "playing" && pauseTimer <= 0) launchBall();
}

// ---------- Input ----------
const keys = new Set();
let mouseActive = false;

window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", " "].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase());
  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") {
    if (!e.repeat) action();
  }
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key.toLowerCase() === "a" || e.key.toLowerCase() === "d") {
    mouseActive = false;
  }
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()));

function pointerToPaddle(clientX) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - PADDLE_W, x - PADDLE_W / 2));
  mouseActive = true;
}

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => pointerToPaddle(e.clientX));
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); action(); });
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  pointerToPaddle(e.touches[0].clientX);
  action();
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  pointerToPaddle(e.touches[0].clientX);
}, { passive: false });

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(dt) {
  if (pauseTimer > 0) {
    pauseTimer -= dt;
    if (pauseTimer <= 0) {
      pauseTimer = 0;
      if (state === "levelClear") {
        loadLevel(levelIndex + 1);
        state = "playing";
      }
      message = "";
    }
  }

  if (state !== "playing") return;

  // Paddle movement via keyboard
  let dir = 0;
  if (keys.has("arrowleft") || keys.has("a")) dir -= 1;
  if (keys.has("arrowright") || keys.has("d")) dir += 1;
  if (dir !== 0) {
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - PADDLE_W, paddle.x + dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt));
  }

  if (ball.stuck) { stickBall(); return; }
  if (pauseTimer > 0) return;

  // Move ball in small steps to avoid tunnelling
  const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((speed * dt) / (BALL_R / 2)));
  const sdt = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    if (stepBall(sdt)) break;
  }
}

// Returns true if the ball's step loop should stop (life lost / level cleared)
function stepBall(dt) {
  ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
  ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

  // Walls
  if (ball.x - BALL_R < 0) { ball.x = BALL_R; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.x + BALL_R > W) { ball.x = W - BALL_R; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.y - BALL_R < 0) { ball.y = BALL_R; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // Fell off the bottom
  if (ball.y - BALL_R > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = "gameOver";
    } else {
      message = "Life lost! " + lives + (lives === 1 ? " life" : " lives") + " left";
      pauseTimer = PAUSE_TIME;
      resetBall();
    }
    return true;
  }

  // Paddle
  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + BALL_R >= PADDLE_Y && ball.y - BALL_R <= PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H &&
      ball.x >= paddle.x - BALL_R && ball.x <= paddle.x + PADDLE_W + BALL_R) {
    const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + PADDLE_W / 2)) / (PADDLE_W / 2); // -1..1
    const clamped = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit));
    const angle = clamped * (Math.PI / 3); // up to 60 degrees from vertical
    const speed = Math.min(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * 1.01, LEVELS[levelIndex].speed * 1.6);
    ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
    ball.y = PADDLE_Y - BALL_R;
  }

  // Bricks: resolve along axis of least penetration
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (b.hp <= 0) continue;
    const nx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + BRICK_W));
    const ny = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + BRICK_H));
    const dx = ball.x - nx, dy = ball.y - ny;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > BALL_R * BALL_R) continue;

    const overlapL = ball.x + BALL_R - b.x;
    const overlapR = b.x + BRICK_W - (ball.x - BALL_R);
    const overlapT = ball.y + BALL_R - b.y;
    const overlapB = b.y + BRICK_H - (ball.y - BALL_R);
    const minX = Math.min(overlapL, overlapR);
    const minY = Math.min(overlapT, overlapB);
    if (minX < minY) {
      if (overlapL < overlapR) { ball.x -= overlapL; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      else { ball.x += overlapR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    } else {
      if (overlapT < overlapB) { ball.y -= overlapT; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy); }
      else { ball.y += overlapB; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
    }

    if (!b.solid) {
      b.hp--;
      score += b.hp <= 0 ? 10 * b.maxHp : 5;
    }
    break; // one brick per step
  }

  // Level cleared?
  if (!bricks.some((b) => !b.solid && b.hp > 0)) {
    score += lives * 50;
    if (levelIndex + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
      state = "levelClear";
      message = "Level " + (levelIndex + 1) + " clear!";
      pauseTimer = PAUSE_TIME * 1.5;
    } else {
      state = "win";
    }
    ball.stuck = true;
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawText(text, x, y, size, color = "#fff", align = "center") {
  ctx.font = `bold ${size}px system-ui, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.textAlign = align;
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 44);
  drawText("Score: " + score, 20, 22, 20, "#fff", "left");
  drawText("Level " + (levelIndex + 1) + " / " + LEVELS.length, W / 2, 22, 20);
  drawText("Lives:", W - 120, 22, 20, "#fff", "right");
  for (let i = 0; i < START_LIVES; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 100 + i * 28, 22, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? "#ff6b81" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (b.hp <= 0) continue;
    const color = b.solid ? COLORS["#"] : COLORS[b.hp];
    roundRect(b.x, b.y, BRICK_W, BRICK_H, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + 3, BRICK_W - 8, 4);
  }
}

function drawPaddleAndBall() {
  roundRect(paddle.x, PADDLE_Y, PADDLE_W, PADDLE_H, 7);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e0e6ff";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff176";
  ctx.fill();
}

function overlay(title, lines) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5,8,20,0.75)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 60, 48, "#fff176");
  lines.forEach((l, i) => drawText(l, W / 2, H / 2 + i * 32, 20, "#ddd"));
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#141a2e";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (state === "title") {
    drawText("BRICK BREAKER", W / 2, H / 2 - 100, 56, "#4fc3f7");
    drawText("Move: Mouse or Arrow keys / A, D", W / 2, H / 2 - 10, 20, "#ddd");
    drawText("Launch: Click, Space or Enter", W / 2, H / 2 + 22, 20, "#ddd");
    drawText("2 levels  -  3 lives", W / 2, H / 2 + 54, 20, "#ddd");
    drawText("Click or press Space to start", W / 2, H / 2 + 120, 24, "#fff176");
    return;
  }

  drawBricks();
  drawPaddleAndBall();
  drawHUD();

  if (state === "playing" && ball.stuck && pauseTimer <= 0) {
    drawText("Click or press Space to launch", W / 2, H / 2 + 80, 20, "#aab");
  }
  if (message && pauseTimer > 0) {
    drawText(message, W / 2, H / 2 + 40, 30, "#fff");
  }
  if (state === "gameOver") {
    overlay("GAME OVER", ["Final score: " + score, "Click or press Space to play again"]);
  } else if (state === "win") {
    overlay("YOU WIN!", ["Final score: " + score, "Click or press Space to play again"]);
  }
}

// ---------- Game loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ---------- Start ----------
loadLevel(0);
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
